fact.en: Thinking all Mahajanapadas were monarchies; remember the Gana-Sanghas (republics) like Vajji.
fact.hi: Thinking all Mahajanapadas were monarchies; remember the Gana-Sanghas (republics) like Vajji.

fact.en: Confusing the geographical location of Asmaka (only one in the south) with others in the Gangetic plain.
fact.hi: Confusing the geographical location of Asmaka (only one in the south) with others in the Gangetic plain.

fact.en: Assuming democratic republics were modern-style; they were oligarchic with power restricted to Kshatriya clans.
